timing: Written after the four-run known-truth smoke passed and before the 20-replicate extension was generated or fitted.
purpose: Test convergence, parsing, identifiability, exact count mapping, and stability of the locked direct-agreement tolerances. This remains a pipeline pilot, not an estimator-performance study.

design.paired_randomness: Within replicate, the two conditions share Person measures and one uniform per response row.
design.immutable_extension: The first two replicates must exactly preserve all four parent manifest rows, ratings, and threshold truth rows.

pilot_gates.input_and_counts: All four parent runs preserved; every generated row belongs to exactly one run; every mapped FACETS scale/category count matches the retained rows.
pilot_gates.identification: Expanded constrained PCM design nullity equals zero for every directly compared run.
pilot_gates.engine_accounting: Every attempted run must be accounted for; at least 95% must return, converge, and be comparison eligible in both engines.
pilot_gates.direct_agreement: At least 95% of attempted runs must individually pass every locked direct tolerance, and aggregate metrics must pass the same tolerances.
pilot_gates.paired_direction: At least 90% of replicate-engine checks must estimate a larger between-Criterion threshold distance under the heterogeneous condition than under the shared condition.

withheld_claims: No estimator bias or RMSE ranking from this pilot.
No interval coverage, fit false-positive, local-bias false-positive, or power claim.
No generalization to named General/Specific scales, mixed category support, recoding, threshold anchors, or more than one # facet.
No automatic estimator recommendation in the Streamlit UI.
